checkpoint_selection: lowest raw validation cross-entropy; earliest tie
patience_reference: reset after cumulative validation CE reduction greater than min_delta
configuration_selection: highest mean selected validation AUROC across all four client counts and three seeds; within 0.002 choose smallest weight decay
mechanism_goal: prefer candidates with practical training-loss stability in all 12 runs and selected validation-minus-training cross-entropy gap at most 0.1 in every run; otherwise mark recommendation provisional
classification_threshold: maximize validation balanced accuracy; ties choose highest threshold
partition: reuse frozen 3600 optimization, 900 validation, 4500 test partitions
optimizer: SGD without momentum; include partial batches
training_stability: existing mixed loss tolerances and five persistent windows; fixed LR for all 33 rounds contributing to those windows; also record original strict criterion
stop: first practical training-loss stability, validation-CE patience, or 300 rounds; restore best validation-CE checkpoint
scope: Continue eight early-stopped revision-2 baselines; retain four stable runs. No new data, parameter grid, attacks, or report changes
revision_rationale: Revision 2 limited all 12 selected validation/train CE gaps to below 0.036; four runs passed full stability and five additional runs passed the loss bounds. Validation patience 60 preempted LR settling. Seven halvings to initial_lr/100 can require 7*(10+1)+6*5=107 plateau rounds; the fixed-LR stability guard requires another 33. Patience 150 gives that sequence time to finish with a small margin. Only patience changes; all training updates, scheduler settings, loss bounds, selection rules and 300 total-round cap remain unchanged. Explicitly verified checkpoint migration preserves revision-2 histories and provenance; incompatible direct caches still reject.
interpretation: predictive early stopping, not optimization convergence
